preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of strings n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) <= 8 for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each string has a length of at most 8 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(s.islower() for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each string consists of lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(s != '' for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()])

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip()) == sum(int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit())
postconditions.description: The output length matches the total number of strings across all test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == n for n, output in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [stdout.strip()[i:i+n] for i in range(0, len(stdout.strip()), n)]))
postconditions.description: Each test case's output is a binary string of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['0', '1'] for i in range(len(stdout.strip())))
postconditions.description: Each character in the output is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.strip()[i] == '1') == any(s_i == s_j + s_k for s_j in strings for s_k in strings if s_i == s_j + s_k) for i, s_i in enumerate(strings))
postconditions.description: For each string s_i in the input, the corresponding output bit is '1' if and only if there exist two strings s_j and s_k (possibly the same) such that s_i is the concatenation of s_j and s_k.
